question: Which Indian Cricketer is known as "The Wall"?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rahul Dravid.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Indian cricketer** known as **"The Wall" **is **Rahul Dravid**, who is widely regarded as one of the **greatest Test batsmen** of all time.
 
• Dravid earned the nickname **"The Wall"** for his ability to bat for **long periods of time** and hold up one end of the **crease, frustrating opposition bowlers.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sachin Tendulkar, **also known as the **"Master Blaster****," **is another** legendary Indian cricketer **who is widely regarded as one of the greatest batsmen of all time.
 
• **Harbhajan Singh** is a former Indian cricketer who was primarily a **spin bowler **and played a key role in India's victory in the **2001 Test series against Australia.**
 
• **Mahendra Singh Dhoni **is a former Indian cricketer and former **captain of the Indian national team,** who is known for his aggressive style of captaincy and finishing skills as a batsman.
